mechanism.description: The saved exception instruction reads through rcx at 0x0000000000000000, matching the access-violation target 0x0000000000000000. This establishes the immediate faulting read; the origin of the pointer is not established.

rootCause.conclusion: The underlying root cause is unknown. A faulting frame or invalid address alone does not establish the defect that produced it.
missingEvidence: Source/runtime evidence tracing the faulting state back to its origin
